payroll_page.forbidden: Only owners, admins and HR can see payroll.

list.title: Payroll (Talab)
list.description: Monthly wage sheets calculated from hajiri, leave and peski — by Bikram Sambat month.
list.empty_body: Create your first wage sheet for a BS month. We calculate it from hajiri automatically.

create.title: New payroll run
create.description: We'll build the wage sheet from hajiri, approved leave and peski for the month.
create.month_hint: One run per month. You can recalculate while it's a draft.
create.festival_description: One month's basic salary, prorated for workers who joined less than a year ago.
create.festival_suggest: {month} is when Dashain allowance is usually paid.
create.duplicate: A payroll run for {month} already exists.

how.title: How payroll works
how.attendance_body: Present, half days, approved leave, holidays and weekly offs decide the payable days.
how.sheet_body: Basic, DA, overtime, SSF 11%, TDS and peski recovery are calculated for every worker.
how.approve_body: Adjust other deductions if needed, then approve. Hajiri for the month gets locked.
how.pay_body: Download the bank transfer file, pay workers, then mark the run as paid. Workers get an SMS.

detail.title: Wage sheet · {month}
detail.not_found: This payroll run doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.
detail.draft_note: This is a draft. Check the wage sheet, adjust deductions if needed, then approve.
detail.approved_note: Approved — hajiri for this month is locked. Pay workers, then mark the run as paid.
detail.paid_note: Paid on {date}. Workers have been notified and peski balances updated.

actions.recalculated: Wage sheet recalculated from the latest hajiri
actions.approve_body: Approving locks hajiri for {month} — attendance can no longer be changed, and the wage sheet can't be recalculated or edited.

mark_paid.title: Mark {month} as paid
mark_paid.description: Marks every payslip as paid, recovers peski instalments and sends workers an SMS.
mark_paid.method_hint: Choose a method only if everyone was paid the same way.

sheet.title: Wage sheet (Talab pana)
sheet.scroll_hint: Scroll sideways to see all columns.

payslip.title: Payslip
payslip.subtitle: {month} · {designation}
payslip.ssf_employer_hint: Paid by the employer to SSF; not deducted from net pay.
payslip.not_found: This payslip is no longer in the list.
payslip.edit_hint: Only possible while the run is a draft. Net pay is recalculated.
payslip.locked: This payslip is locked because the run is {status}.
payslip.note_placeholder: Reason for the deduction, visible on the payslip
payslip.invalid_amount: Enter a valid amount (up to 2 decimals)
payslip.too_large: Deduction can't make net pay negative
